items.html: *And we shall now explain what is the matter of these three Mochin. Behold, through the suckling of the milk during these two years, the Mochin within him were filled. As is known, the milk is drawn from what the supernal Ima returns to clarify within herself — that aspect which could not be clarified in her womb in the secret of pregnancy. And now they are clarified and become milk, as above, and ZA nurses from it and grows, and then the Mochin within him are filled.
